verdict.rationale: Google Workspace exposes admin APIs, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack never documents OAuth scopes, service accounts, delegated or least-privilege API keys, or any way to issue narrowly scoped credentials. Context-Aware Access policies and 2SV enforcement control human or app sign-in, not API credential scoping, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
